task: Existing WPF-001-05 / WPF-REQ-22/23 complete plugin system

findings.fact: SlotId and manifest validation accept chat.composer.context panels and button/menu contributions, but current product JSX has no generic subscribeSlot/chat.composer.context + renderer enumeration or AppSlot consumer for that slot. Knowledge and attachment render their own fixed panel IDs.
findings.implication: Declaring a new valid composer-context contribution alone does not make it appear; current builtins do not establish arbitrary plugin composition coverage.
findings.qualification: Static extensibility gap; not a browser-observed failure of the existing builtin attachment/knowledge panels.

findings.fact: ResourceContext.message accepts user and assistant. Product MessageFooter returns only stream draft status for recognized assistant drafts, then returns null unless a task is mapped and role=user. Generic panel/button/menu enumeration therefore applies only to user message footers.
findings.implication: A valid extension targeting an assistant message footer is not rendered by this consumer. Existing message-actions support both roles, and stream-draft status must remain separate.
findings.qualification: Existing footer implementation may intentionally attach stream status to user messages; this is a complete-plugin-system scope gap, not evidence that streaming itself fails.

designConstraints: Use existing host registry, capability checks, PluginView/ExtensionSlot, and existing Thread component injection points; do not add a second plugin store or host.
Define per-pane composer context ownership and mount policy; generic enumeration must not double-render existing builtin dialogs or eagerly activate hidden panels.
Preserve existing material/knowledge ownership, draft generation, auth revoke, hidden split pane and dispose behavior; no generic raw DOM mutation hook.
Choose documented footer availability by role, or render authorized assistant contributions alongside preserved stream status; contribution absence must not be silently called full coverage.
acceptanceForExistingPlan: A sample external-to-builtin contribution appears in composer-context and assistant-final footer without editing App/Thread integration code.
Two split panes with distinct view/task contexts invoke the matching command, preserve drafts, and use unique DOM ids.
Enable, disable, failed activation, removal and auth revoke hide/clean only the matching contribution; builtin knowledge/material UI is not duplicated.
Both themes, narrow viewport, native keyboard/focus restoration and reduced motion; a hidden pane does not fetch or activate contributions just to enumerate metadata.
nonChanges: No project edits, claim, new task, tests, server or browser calls.
Generic plugins/react.tsx PluginTabs uses unprefixed IDs, but current production uses WorkspaceContributions with useId; no production duplicate-ID defect is claimed.
methods: Existing local codebase-design: deepen the existing registry consumer instead of scattering per-plugin conditionals.
Existing clean-code: one ownership model, distinguish declared API from actual rendered coverage; avoid speculative abstraction.
